cadence.micro: On every result, event, failed check, stale head, branch update, or missing receipt.
cadence.meso: After each dependency return or child-repo batch, recompile direct and indirect impacts.
cadence.macro: At each golden-priority burn, assess portfolio readiness, live gates, and cross-repo blast radius.
cadence.meta: At each framework change, revise the protocol, templates, skills, and failure corpus from observed misses.

default_next_action: Assess highest-reach impact, repair the source, then re-run dependent checks.
